statement:
theorem divides_trans (hab : Divides a b) (hbc : Divides b c) :
    Divides a c := by
  sorry

mappings.source_form: If $a \mid b$ and $b \mid c$, then $a \mid c$.
mappings.lean_form: Divides a b → Divides b c → Divides a c
mappings.justification: The two hypotheses become binders; the conclusion is unchanged.
